expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the block + hash milestone with TODOs; no full chain with PoW, transactions, P2P
expectations.evidence: blockchain.py is a milestone-1 scaffold only: compute_hash has 'TODO(你来写, 3 行以内)' and 'raise NotImplementedError("轮到你了: 实现 compute_hash")'; no chain/PoW/transactions/P2P code exists, and PROGRESS.md lists milestones 2-5 as '未开始'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Answer ends with checkpoint: '检查（写完后跑两次）：python3 blockchain.py' plus expected output 'index: 0 / data: genesis / prev: 0 / hash: <64位十六进制>' and pass criteria '两次运行 hash 完全一致；hash 长度是 64；把 data="genesis" 临时改成 "genesis!"…hash 应完全变样'

expectations.text: B3: Block hash covers index/timestamp/data/previous hash via SHA-256
expectations.evidence: TODO specifies '把 index/timestamp/data/previous_hash 按固定顺序放进一个 dict … json.dumps(dict, sort_keys=True) … hashlib.sha256(字节).hexdigest() 返回 64 位十六进制字符串'; concept section explains 'SHA-256 是个单向函数'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command run is 'ls -la && python3 --version' (no install); files written are PROGRESS.md and blockchain.py inside the project; docstring states '只用标准库, 无需安装任何东西'
